blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.
blocks.zh: 本文探讨了从稀有和低分辨率的捕捉资源中创建浸泡式卷片的问题. 常规密集多景重建方法可以产生出高质量的量子视频,但是它们依赖于昂贵的捕捉设置使得它们在现实世界的情景中不切实际. 近期的方法使用基因模型来放松捕捉要求,但仍然受到分辨率有限和4D不一致的影响. 为了克服这些制约因素,我们提议RealMe,一个围绕高分辨率视频传播模式所构建的统一框架,这个模式能增强有限的捕捉到高分辨率(2K),4D相容的视频,用于量产视频重建. 具体来说,真实 我从捕捉视频中构建辅助数据,并将视频编码为潜伏数据,同时进行布局意识定位嵌入. 视频传播模型对多视图捕捉布局进行了因地制宜的spatio-timperal关注,将这些潜伏物在观点和时间上进行分解,并解码为增强的视频来完善4D表现. 这一改编有助于模型捕捉时间动态和多视角关系,导致更多4D相容的生成. 为了缩小生成的视频与真实捕获之间的数据差距,我们采用了潜在的频率损失,在潜在的空间中提供频率域监督. 对公共DNA渲染基准和我们自拍的RealVV数据集的广泛实验表明,RealMe能够在视觉忠心度和4D一致性方面创造出浸泡性卷片并超越最先进的方法.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Volumetric videos capture dynamic scenes from multiple viewpoints and support free-viewpoint rendering.
The immersive and interactive nature of volumetric videos makes them an effective medium for applications such as metaverse, telepresence, VR/AR, and gaming.
Previous methods ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024c ; Wang et al., 2025e ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) have achieved high-quality volumetric video reconstruction and novel view synthesis by directly optimizing 4D scene representations.
However, these approaches typically rely on dense and well-controlled capture setups that provide sufficient multi-view observations for reconstruction.
This requirement makes them impractical under constrained acquisition settings, where only sparse camera arrays or low-quality input videos are available.
Consequently, creating volumetric videos from limited captures while approaching the visual quality and 4D consistency of dense multi-view capture remains a critical research problem and the primary motivation for our work.

然而,这些方法通常依靠密集和控制良好的捕捉装置,为重建提供足够的多视图观测。
这一要求使得它们在受限制的获取设置下不切实际,因为那里只有稀少的相机阵列或低质量的输入视频.

blocks.en:
The central challenge is to infer global scene structure and fine details from partial observations while preserving 4D consistency.
Recent work has explored using generative models ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ) to reduce capture requirements, leveraging their learned priors for realistic, high-quality synthesis.
Some approaches ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025b ) adopt a two-stage optimization pipeline, using generative models to repair degraded renderings before refining the scene representation, thereby improving video resolution and frame rate.
However, their generation stage treats each viewpoint independently, ignoring multi-view correlations and causing cross-view spatial inconsistency.
The two-stage pipeline also introduces error accumulation between generation and reconstruction.
To address this limitation, another line of work ( Wu et al., 2025c ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) uses spatio-temporal attention during generation to facilitate information flow across spatial and temporal dimensions, producing more 4D-consistent results.
Despite improved consistency, these approaches still require large-scale training data and remain limited by current generative backbones,
whose native resolutions are often below 1K and therefore fall short of the visual quality required for volumetric video creation.
blocks.zh:
中心挑战是从局部观测中推断出全球场景结构和细微细节,同时保持4D一致性.
最近的工作探索了使用基因模型(Brooks等人,2024年;Esser等人,2024年;Team Wan等人,2025年)来降低捕捉要求,利用他们所学的前科进行现实而高质量的合成.
一些取法(Shen等人,2024;Chen等人,2025a;Wu等人,2025b)采用两相优化管线,使用基因模型来修复已退化的渲染后再完善场景表现,从而提高了视频分辨率和帧率.
然而,它们的生成阶段独立地对待每个观点,忽略了多视角的关联性,并导致交叉视角空间不一致.
两阶段管道还引入了生成与重建之间的错误积累.
为解决这一限制,另一行工作(Wu等,2025c;Jin等,2025;Huang等,2025)在生成过程中使用时空注意力来推动跨空间和时间维度的信息流动,产生更多与4D相符合的结果.
尽管一致性有所提高,但这些方法仍需要大规模培训数据,并且仍然受到目前遗传性骨干的限制,
他们的原生分辨率往往低于1K,因此没有达到量子视频制作所需的视觉质量.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-quality, 4D-consistent videos for subsequent volumetric video reconstruction.
Specifically, given sparse and low-quality captures, RealMe first constructs auxiliary videos from input captures using diverse degradation strategies.
These auxiliary videos are encoded into conditional latents, each associated with a layout-aware positional embedding that describes its spatial, temporal, and latent-space information.
Our video diffusion model takes these conditional latents and noise as input and decodes the denoised latents into enhanced videos.
Building on prior factorized video attention ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ) , we adapt the factorization to the sampled video groups, allowing denoising to propagate information separately along the temporal and spatial dimensions rather than over a flattened token sequence.
As shown in Sec. 5.3.2 , this adaptation improves visual fidelity and downstream 4D consistency over full attention.
The generated videos and the original captures are used to optimize the scene representation ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Wu et al., 2024 ) for volumetric video reconstruction.
To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that guides the predicted latent to preserve low-frequency structure while recovering high-frequency details.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出RealMe,一个围绕高分辨率视频传播模型所构建的统一框架,它能增强有限的捕捉到高质量,4D相容的视频,用于后续的量产视频重建.
具体地说,由于捕捉到的很少而且质量低, 我首先用不同的退化策略 构建从输入捕获的辅助视频。
这些辅助视频被编码成有条件的潜入,每个潜入都与描述其空间、时间和潜入空间信息的布局意识位置嵌入有关。
我们的视频传播模式将这些有条件的潜伏和噪音作为输入,并解码被解码为被增强的视频.
基于之前的因子化视频关注(Bertasius等,2021年),我们将因地制宜的因子化适用于被取样的视频组,允许取名者在时间和空间维度上分别传播信息,而不是通过平分的道具序列来传播.
如第5.3.2节所显示,这种调整比充分注意提高了视觉的忠诚度和下游的4D一致性。
所生成的视频和原始取景被用来优化场景表现(Wang等,2025e; Wu等,2024),为量产视频重建.
为了缩小生成的视频与真实捕获之间的数据差距,我们采用了潜在的频率损失,引导所预测的潜在值在恢复高频细节的同时保持低频结构.

blocks.en:
Although existing public benchmarks ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Isik et al., 2023 ) provide high-quality multi-view data, they are mostly captured in object-centric studio settings with the same focal-length multi-view camera arrays and do not fully cover long focal-length views or diverse real-world degradations.
To evaluate our method under more realistic and challenging acquisition settings, we curate a self-captured dataset dubbed RealVV , which contains multi-view videos with varying focal lengths, diverse scenes, actors, and performances, as well as both real and synthetic degradations.
We evaluate RealMe on both the public DNA-Rendering benchmark ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) and RealVV under limited capture settings.
Extensive experiments show that RealMe is capable of creating high-quality volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.
blocks.zh:
虽然现有的公用基准(Cheng等,2023;Isik等,2023)提供了高质量的多视图数据,但它们大多是在以物体为中心的工作室环境中被捕获的,具有相同的焦长多视图相机阵列,并不完全覆盖了长焦长相或多样的真人世界退化.
为了在更现实和更具挑战性的获取设置下评价我们的方法,我们整理了一个自我捕获的被誉为"RealVV"的数据集,其中包含多景视频,具有不同的焦距,不同的场景,演员和表演,以及真实和合成的退化.
在有限的捕捉设置下,我们用公开的DNA渲染基准(Cheng等,2023年)和RealVV来评价RealMe。
广泛的实验表明RealMe能够创造出高质量的量子视频,并在视觉忠心和4D一致性方面超越最先进的方法.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose RealMe, a unified framework for high-resolution 4D enhancement that reduces the capture requirements for high-quality volumetric video reconstruction. • We adapt a pretrained high-resolution image diffusion model ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) to 4D enhancement using layout-aware positional embeddings and factorized spatio-temporal attention. The adapted model is trained with a latent frequency loss to reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures. • We curate RealVV , a self-captured multi-view dataset with diverse degradations to support volumetric video evaluation under challenging settings and plan to release it to the community.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Dense-View 4D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1. 广视4D 重建

blocks.en:
Existing volumetric video reconstruction methods typically start from multi-view videos and optimize a time-varying scene representation for free-viewpoint rendering.
Recent systems ( Luiten et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024b ) model dynamic content with persistent primitives, 4D fields, or spatio-temporal features.
To improve temporal scale and motion coverage, specialized representations ( Xu et al., 2024c ; Wang et al., 2025e ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) handle long sequences, complex motion, casual videos, and human-centric topology.
Other methods ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025c ) reduce reconstruction cost with deformation fields, dynamic particles, or lightweight monocular pipelines.
Although these methods improve reconstruction quality and efficiency, they still rely on the captured frames as direct optimization evidence.
Their performance therefore drops when the input views are sparse or visually degraded, which motivates an explicit enhancement stage before reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
现有的量子视频重建方法一般从多视图视频入手,并优化了时间变化的场景表现来进行自由取景渲染.
近代系统(Luiten等,2024;Wu等,2024;Li等,2024;Xu等,2024b) 有持久原始,4D字段,或spatio-时空特征的模型活性含量.
为了提高时间尺度和运动覆盖范围,专门表述(徐等,2024c;王等,2025e;李等,2025;江等,2025)处理长序,复杂运动,临时视频,以人为中心的地貌.
其他方法(杨等,2024b;林等,2024;吴等,2025a; Wang等,2025c.)以变形场,活性颗粒或轻量级单管来降低重建成本.
虽然这些方法提高了重建质量和效率,但仍然依靠所捕获的帧作为直接优化的证据.
因此,当投入视图稀少或视觉退化时,它们的性能会下降,这促使重建前有一个明显的增强阶段。

blocks.en: 2.2. Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2. Sparse-View 4D 重建

blocks.en:
Sparse-view 4D reconstruction uses additional priors to reduce capture requirements.
Geometry-aware and completion methods ( Mihajlovic et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025d ; Wang et al., 2025f ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2023 ) use neural fields, correspondences, monocular fusion, structured point features, flow guidance, or geometric constraints to recover structure from partial observations, including limited-view optimization and four-view capture.
A related sparse-frame formulation ( Shi et al., 2026 ) instead addresses temporal undersampling with texture-aware regularization.
Feed-forward and generative approaches ( Sabathier et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Kong et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025c ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) reduce per-scene optimization with learned reconstruction modules or use diffusion priors, including multi-view video models and transferred 3D/video priors, to synthesize missing observations and pseudo-view supervision.
Human-centric approaches ( Xu et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) further reduce capture requirements by using body structure or learned human priors.
These approaches make sparse capture more feasible, but they mainly solve reconstruction or category-specific rendering within a fixed input setting.
They do not directly address how to turn limited captured videos into higher-fidelity inputs that preserve the capture layout for a general volumetric video pipeline.
blocks.zh:
Sparse-view 4D重建使用额外的前缀来降低捕获要求.
几何感知和完成方法(Mihajlovic等,2024;Wang等,2025d;Wang等,2025f;Zhou等,2026;Hu等,2025;Su等,2023) 使用神经场,函授,单体聚变,结构化点特征,流导等几何约束,从部分观测中恢复结构,包括限视优化和四视捕捉等.
相关的稀有框架制剂(Shi等人,2026年)则涉及用纹理知觉正规化进行时间下取样的问题。
饲料法和基因方法(Sabathier等人, ; 2025; Chen等, 2025b; Kong等, 2025b; Wu等, 2025c; Zhang等, 2024; Liu等, 2026; Jin等, 2025; Huang等, 2025)) 以所学的重建模块或使用多视图视频模型等传播前科来减少人均场面优化,并转移3D/视频前科,以合成缺失的观测和伪视图监督.
以人为中心的方法(徐等,2024a; Zheng等人, 2024; Sun等人, 2025; Xiao等人, 2025)通过使用身体结构或学习人类前科,进一步降低捕获要求.
这些方法使得很少的捕捉更加可行,但它们主要在固定的输入设置中解决重建或特定类别的渲染.
它们没有直接涉及如何将有限的被捕获的视频转化为更可靠的输入,以维护一般量产视频管道的捕获布局。

blocks.en: 2.3. Generative Priors for 4D Enhancement
blocks.zh: 2.3. 4D增强的基因前传

blocks.en:
Generative priors offer a complementary route for improving low-quality videos before they are used for reconstruction.
Video restoration and super-resolution methods ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2025 ) use generative or diffusion models to recover realistic details, stabilize temporal changes, and handle real-world degradations.
However, these models are typically designed for monocular video super-resolution, where the goal is to enhance a single video stream rather than jointly enhance multi-view captures for 4D reconstruction.
Several reconstruction pipelines use video models to increase effective frame rates ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) or repair inferior renderings ( Philip et al., 2025 ) .
While effective, these uses of video priors remain tied to individual streams or rendered outputs rather than reconstructed representations.
Other methods use image-generation models to refine reconstructed representations ( Wu et al., 2025b ) but are limited to static scenes.
As a result, they do not jointly model the camera, timestamp, and image-plane layout that determines 4D consistency across capture inputs.
Large video generation and enhancement models ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ) offer a strong prior for spatio-temporal synthesis, but they require layout-aware adaptation before they can be used for multi-view capture enhancement.
RealMe builds on this direction by conditioning video diffusion on the 4D capture layout.
blocks.zh:
基因前科在用于重建之前,为改进低质量视频提供了一条补充路线。
视频修复和超解析方法(徐等,2025;王等,2025b;王等,2025a; Zhu等,2025;韩等,2025) 使用基因或传播模型来取回现实细节,稳定时间变化,并处理现实世界的退化.
然而,这些模型一般是为单相机视频超解析而设计的,目标是增强单一的视频流,而不是为4D重建共同增强多视图捕获.
几条重建管线使用视频模型来提高有效帧率(沈等,2024;陈等,2025a)或修复下等渲染(菲利普等,2025.
视频前科的这些使用虽然有效,但仍与单个流程或产出有关,而不是重新表述。
其他方法使用图像生成模型来完善被重建的表示(Wu等,2025b.),但仅限于静态场景.
因此,它们不共同模拟相机,时间戳和图像-平面布局,从而决定了整个捕捉输入的4D一致性.
大型的视频生成和增强模型(Brooks等,2024;He等,2024;Team Wan等,2025)为斯皮提奥-时空合成提供了很强的前置性,但需要进行布局-意识改造后才能用于多视图捕获增强.
RealMe通过在4D捕捉布局上对视频传播进行调制,以此为方向.

blocks.en:
Figure 2. Overview of our framework. Given sparse and low-quality captures, RealMe first initializes a coarse 4DGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) representation and uses it to render novel-view videos; in parallel, we detect ROIs with an offline detector ( Guo and Deng, 2024 ) and crop the input captures to preserve local detail cues.
These auxiliary videos are fed into a high-resolution video diffusion model to produce enhanced videos, which are then used together with the input captures to optimize the 4DGS representation for volumetric video reconstruction.
The detailed model architecture is illustrated in Fig. 3 . Overview of the RealMe framework, from limited input captures through auxiliary data construction and video enhancement to 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:

blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Overview

Given sparse and low-quality captures of a dynamic scene, our target is to reconstruct a high-quality and 4D-consistent volumetric video that supports free-viewpoint rendering.
To achieve this goal, we propose RealMe, a unified 4D enhancement framework.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , RealMe first derives auxiliary videos from the input captures ( Sec. 3.2 ).
We then adapt the pretrained high-resolution image diffusion model ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) to use these auxiliary videos as conditions for generating enhanced videos for 4D reconstruction ( Sec. 3.3 ).
The detailed model architecture, including layout-aware positional embeddings and factorized spatio-temporal attention, is shown in Fig. 3 .
To train the model, we construct paired training examples from our self-captured dataset with diverse degradations and formulate the training objectives ( Sec. 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.3. 4D Enhancement Video Diffusion Model
blocks.zh: 3.3. 4D增强视频传播模型

blocks.en:
Mainstream video diffusion models ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) provide strong video priors, but their native resolutions are typically lower than the 2K resolution required by our volumetric video reconstruction pipeline.
We therefore adopt the pretrained high-resolution image diffusion model FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) as our base model.
blocks.zh:
主流视频传播模式(Team Wan等,2025;Yang等,2024a)提供强力视频前传,但其本土分辨率通常低于我们量产视频重建管道所要求的2K分辨率.
因此,我们采用经过预先训练的高分辨率图像传播模型FLUX(黑森林实验室,2024年)作为我们的基础模型。

blocks.en:
However, image diffusion models cannot be directly applied to our 4D enhancement task.
Since these models are originally designed for single-image generation, frame-wise or view-wise enhancement would make the denoising processes of different samples independent, ignoring temporal and multi-view dependencies.
Such independent processing may preserve local details within each frame, but it introduces appearance drift across time and geometry mismatch across viewpoints.
These inconsistencies degrade the enhanced videos and make the downstream volumetric video reconstruction less reliable.
blocks.zh:
然而,图像传播模型不能直接应用于我们的4D增强任务.
由于这些模型最初是为单一图像生成而设计的,因此帧或视距增强将使不同样本的去诺化过程独立,而忽略了时间和多视图的依赖性.
这种独立的处理方式可能保留每个框架内的局部细节,但它引入了跨时间的外观漂移和不同角度的几何不匹配.
这些不一致之处使增强的视频退化,使下游的量子视频重建更加不可靠.

blocks.en:
To address this issue, we adapt the image diffusion model into a spatio-temporal video diffusion model for 4D enhancement.
We first describe the model architecture, where the auxiliary videos constructed in Sec. 3.2 are used as conditions to guide generation.
We then extend the original positional IDs with temporal and spatial indices to represent the structure of each sampled video group.
Finally, we adapt factorized spatio-temporal attention to these groups so information propagates separately along the temporal and spatial dimensions during denoising.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们把图像传播模型改编为斯皮提奥-时相视频传播模型来进行4D增强.
我们首先描述了模型建筑,在Sec. 3.2中构建的辅助视频被用作指导生成的条件.
然后,我们用时间和空间指数来扩展原始位置标识,以代表每个被取样的视频组的结构。
最后,我们调整了对这些群体的因地制宜的时空关注,因此信息在去诺伊化时会沿着时间和空间维度分开传播。

blocks.en: 3.3.1. Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.3.1. 示范建筑

blocks.en:
The model architecture of our video diffusion model is shown in Fig. 3 .
Given auxiliary input videos 𝒱 aux \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{aux}} and a text prompt, we use a frozen VAE encoder to obtain condition latents z L z_{L} and a frozen text encoder to obtain text features c text c_{\mathrm{text}} .
Both z L z_{L} and c text c_{\mathrm{text}} are fed into the ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) branch, which outputs control signals c L c_{L} to each DiT block.
In parallel, we sample Gaussian noise z 1 z_{1} as the initial video latent and feed it to the DiT together with the text features.
At each denoising step, the noisy latents pass through DiT blocks, where control signals are added as conditioning residuals and layout-aware positional embeddings are applied in the attention layers.
The DiT blocks then denoise the latents via factorized spatio-temporal attention, transforming z 1 z_{1} into z 0 z_{0} after N N steps.
Finally, the VAE decoder decodes z 0 z_{0} into enhanced videos.

我们的视频传播模型的模型架构见图3.
考虑到辅助输入视频 V aux\ mathcal{V}_{\ mathrm{aux} 和文本提示,我们使用被冻结的 VAE 编码器来获取条件潜伏 z L z_{L} 和被冻结的文本编码器来获取文本特性 c_{\ mathrm{ text}}.
z L z_{L}和 c text c_{\mathrm{text}}} 都输入到 ControlNet (Zhang等, 2023) 分支中, 分支输出控制信号 c L c_{L} 到每个 DiT 块.
同时,我们将高斯噪声z 1 z_{1}作为初始视频潜入物进行取样,并连同文本特征一起输入到DiT.
在每一个去诺音步骤上,噪音潜入会从DiT区块中穿过,这里会加入控制信号作为调节后剩余部分,并应用布局-意识位置嵌入到注意力层.
DiT区块再通过分解的斯皮提-时相注意来将潜伏物分解出,在N步骤后将z 1 z _{ 1} 转化为z 0 z 0}.
最后,VAE解码器将z 0 z_{0}解码为增强视频.

blocks.en:
During training, we update only the ControlNet module and the LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) in selected DiT transformer modules.
The VAE, text encoder, and remaining pretrained DiT parameters are frozen.

VAE,文本编码器,以及所剩的被预先训练的DiT参数被冻结.

blocks.en: 3.3.2. Layout-Aware Positional Embedding
blocks.zh: 3.3.2. 布局-智能定位嵌入

blocks.en:
The original image identifiers (IDs) specify a three-axis layout coordinate, where the first axis is fixed for image tokens and the other two axes indicate the latent-grid position.
Such IDs are sufficient for single images, but they become ambiguous for sampled video groups.
Tokens from different frames or viewpoints may share the same latent-grid coordinate and therefore receive the same positional signal.
blocks.zh:
最初的图像标识符(ID)指定了三轴布局坐标,其中一轴被固定为图像符,而另外两轴则表示潜在-网格位置.
这样的 ID对于单个图像来说是足够的,但是对于被抽样的视频组来说却变得模糊.
来自不同框架或观点的指针可能共用同一种潜在-网格坐标并因此收到同一种位置信号。

blocks.en:
To remove this ambiguity, we extend the original three-axis IDs to four-dimensional layout-aware IDs.
For a latent token at frame t t , view s s , and grid coordinate ( u , v ) (u,v) , we define: (4) 𝐢𝐝 t , s , u , v = ( t , s , u , v ) , 0 ≤ t < T , 0 ≤ s < S . \mathbf{id}_{t,s,u,v}=(t,s,u,v),\quad 0\leq t<T,\quad 0\leq s<S. Here, T T and S S denote the number of frames and viewpoints in the sampled video group.
The first two axes represent the temporal and spatial layout, while the last two axes preserve the latent-grid position.

前两轴代表了时间和空间布局,而后两轴则保留了潜在的-网格位置.

blocks.en:
The positional embedding is then computed by applying rotary positional encoding ( Su et al., 2024 ) over the four axes: (5) PE ⁡ ( 𝐢𝐝 t , s , u , v ) = ϕ t ​ ( t ) | ϕ s ​ ( s ) ​ ‖ ϕ u ​ ( u ) ‖ ​ ϕ v ​ ( v ) , \mathrm{PE}(\mathbf{id}_{t,s,u,v})=\phi_{t}(t)\|\phi_{s}(s)\|\phi_{u}(u)\|\phi_{v}(v), where ϕ t , ϕ s , ϕ u , ϕ v \phi_{t},\phi_{s},\phi_{u},\phi_{v} denote RoPE mappings for each axis and their output dimensions sum to the per-head rotary dimension.
Thus, tokens with the same latent-grid position are still distinguished by their spatial and temporal indices.

因此,具有同样潜在网格位置的标志仍然被空间指数和时间指数所区分。

blocks.en: 3.3.3. Factorized Spatio-Temporal Attention
blocks.zh: 3.3.3. 因素化的空间-时间注意

blocks.en:
Prior work has factorized video attention along spatial and temporal axes ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ) . We apply this principle to the sampled video groups, where the spatial axis indexes viewpoints rather than image patches.
The original attention mechanism concatenates the latent tokens of all samples into a long token sequence and applies full attention over the sequence.
Although this allows information exchange across samples, the samples are originally drawn from a temporal and spatial layout, and full attention does not utilize these layout relationships.
Therefore, we replace full attention with factorized spatio-temporal attention, which decomposes information propagation into temporal and spatial attention patterns.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作使视频对空间轴和时间轴的注意因素化(Bertasius等,2021年)。 我们把这一原则应用到被取样的视频组中,在视频组中,空间轴会显示观点而不是图像补丁。
原始的注意机制将所有样本中的潜在活物分解成一个很长的活物序列,并在序列上充分关注.
虽然这样可以进行样本之间的信息交流,但样本最初是从时间和空间布局中抽取的,没有充分的注意没有利用这些布局关系.
因此,我们用因地制宜的时空关注来取代充分关注,这种关注将信息传播分解为时间和空间关注模式。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 4 , each blue square in the top row denotes the latent token sequence of each sample.
The labels T T and S S denote the temporal and spatial indices of the sample in the sampled group, respectively.
After projection, these latent tokens form query, key, and value tokens for attention.
In each attention map, the horizontal axis denotes key/value tokens from the samples and the vertical axis denotes query tokens from the samples.
Each small block therefore corresponds to a sample pair, where an active block indicates that the sample pair participates in dot-product attention and an inactive block indicates that it is excluded under the current attention pattern.
We implement this adaptation by reshaping the latent tokens before attention, so attention is performed separately along the temporal and spatial dimensions and then restored to the original shape after attention.
Our ablation study further indicates that this factorized adaptation improves the 4D consistency of generated videos over full attention.
blocks.zh:

标签T T和S S分别表示被抽样组中样本的时间和空间指数.
投影后,这些潜伏的活符会形成查询,键和值活符来引起注意.
在每个注意地图中,水平轴表示从样本中取出密钥/值符,而垂直轴表示从样本中取出查询符.
因此,每个小块对应一对样本,其中活性块表示样本对参与点产品注意,活性块表示它被排除于当前注意模式下.
我们通过在注意之前重塑潜在的象征来进行这种调整,因此注意是按时间和空间维度分开进行的,然后在注意之后恢复到原来的形状。
我们的消化研究进一步表明,这种因子化的适应性改善了所生成视频的4D一致性,超过了充分关注.

blocks.en: 3.4. Model Training and Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.4. 示范培训和优化

blocks.en: 3.4.1. Training Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.4.1. 培训数据审查

blocks.en:
To train the video diffusion model, we curate RealVV , a high-resolution multi-view video dataset with diverse scenes, actors, performances, and camera settings, including both short-focus and long-focus views.
The training split contains 100 sequences from 20 actors.
Each sequence has 48 to 80 views, with 300 frames per view.
In total, the training split contains over 1.4 million multi-view images.
We hold out the evaluation sequences and exclude them from training.
From the remaining training sequences, we construct paired training examples.
Each pair contains a clean target video and a degraded condition video.
The target provides high-resolution supervision with consistent observations, while the degraded video follows the form of the auxiliary videos used at inference time.
blocks.zh:
为了训练视频传播模式,我们管理RealVV,这是一个高分辨率多视图视频数据集,有不同的场景,演员,表演,以及相机设置,包括短焦点和长焦点视图.
训练分会包含由20名演员组成的100个序列.
每个序列有48到80个视图,每个视图有300个帧.
训练分会总共包含140多万个多视图图像.
我们坚持评价顺序,将他们排除在培训之外。
从其余的培训序列中,我们构建了对等的培训实例。
每对都包含一个干净的目标视频和一个退化状态视频.
目标提供高分辨度监督,进行一致的观测,而被退化的视频遵循了推断时使用的辅助视频的形式.

blocks.en:
We synthesize the degraded condition videos using three degradation strategies:
(1) Sparse-view and underfit reconstruction degradation.
We reconstruct a coarse 4DGS from sparse views or an intentionally underfit optimization and render novel-view videos with artifacts.
(2) Resolution degradation.
We apply cropping, resizing, and downsampling to high-resolution videos to obtain low-resolution or ROI-limited videos.
(3) Appearance and motion degradation.
Following the synthetic degradation strategy of Real-ESRGAN ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , we add random noise, compression artifacts, defocus blur, and motion blur to simulate common appearance and motion degradations in real captures.
Combined with the first two strategies, these perturbations approximate the artifacts present in auxiliary videos and real captures.
blocks.zh:
我们用三种降解策略 合成退化状态视频:
(1) Sparse-view和不适应的重建退化。
我们重建一个粗糙的4DGS 从稀有的视野或有意的不匹配优化, 并制作小说-视觉视频 与文物。
(2) 分解退化。
我们对高分辨度的视频进行收割、再大小化和下采样,以获取低分辨度或ROI限量的视频。
(3)外观和运动退化.

3.4.3. 4D Reconstruction

The enhanced videos generated by the video diffusion model are used together with the input captures to refine the scene representation and reconstruct the volumetric video.
For both scene initialization and reconstruction, we adopt FTGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) as the underlying 4DGS method, which supports dynamic scene reconstruction with time-varying Gaussian primitives.
The final 4DGS is jointly supervised by the original captures, enhanced novel-view videos, and enhanced ROI videos.
We map each enhanced ROI video back to its full-frame camera coordinates using the recorded crop boxes and optimize a unified 4D Gaussian representation for the full scene.

对于两个场景的初始化和重建,我们采用FTGS(Wang等人,2025e)作为基础的4DGS方法,它支持动态场景重建与时差的高斯原始人.
最终的4DGS由原作取景,增强小说取景视频,增强ROI视频共同监督.
我们利用收录的收割盒,将每个增强的ROI视频映射到其全帧相机坐标上,并优化整个场景的统一4D高斯代表.

blocks.en: 4. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4. 实施细节

blocks.en:
We use the DiffSynth-Studio ( ModelScope Community, 2024 ) framework for model training and inference.
The pretrained base model is the 14B FLUX.1 [dev] model ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) .
We initialize the ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) branch from the pretrained DiT weights and train the full branch during adaptation.
During training, we use mixed temporal, spatial, and joint sampling, with detailed model and sampling configurations provided in the supplementary material.
We train the model for 96 hours on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with an effective batch size of 8 and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and set the frequency loss weight to 0.1.
To reduce memory usage, we use bfloat16 mixed-precision training and gradient checkpointing.
Training target videos are generated at 2560 × 1440 2560\times 1440 resolution, while condition videos are resized to 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution.

blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 实验

blocks.en: 5.1. Settings
5.1.1. Datasets

We evaluate RealMe on our self-captured RealVV dataset and the public DNA-Rendering benchmark ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . RealVV is a high-resolution multi-view video dataset containing diverse scenes, actors, performances, and camera settings, including both short-focus and long-focus cameras.
We use seven sequences for evaluation, all excluded from the training data.
Each evaluation sequence contains 48 views, with 180 frames per view, and is evaluated at a resolution of 2560 × 1440 2560\times 1440 .
We select eight spatially distributed views as input captures and use the remaining views for novel-view evaluation.
A detailed analysis of input-view settings is provided in Sec. 5.3.1 .
DNA-Rendering ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) contains diverse human performances with different outfits and dynamic motions.
We select four sequences for zero-shot evaluation, each with 120 frames per view, and evaluate them at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution.
We follow the same input and evaluation protocol as RealVV , using eight input views and the remaining views for novel-view evaluation.

blocks.en: 5.1.2. Baselines

We evaluate RealMe on multiple tasks to assess its performance across several aspects.
(1) Novel view synthesis measures the visual quality of rendered novel views.
We use FTGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) as a strong 4DGS-based reconstruction baseline and DIFIX3D+ ( Wu et al., 2025b ) as a generative baseline for novel-view enhancement.
We additionally include 4C4D ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , which is designed for four-camera sparse-view reconstruction, and 4K4D ( Xu et al., 2024b ) , a high-fidelity 4D view synthesis method.
(2) 4D-consistent reconstruction tests whether the enhanced videos preserve 4D consistency for high-quality 4DGS reconstruction.
We compare with Diffuman4D ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , a generation-based sparse-view reconstruction method.
(3) Detail enhancement focuses on recovering fine appearance details from low-quality captures.
We benchmark against STAR ( Xie et al., 2025 ) and FlashVSR ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) , two video super-resolution baselines for degraded video inputs.
The implementation details and settings for the baselines are described in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5.1.3. Metrics

We report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS as quantitative metrics.
PSNR and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) measure pixel-level and structural fidelity, while LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measures perceptual similarity.
blocks.zh:
我们把PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS 报告为定量衡量标准。
PSNR和SSIM(Wang等,2004年)测量像素水平和结构忠诚度,而LPIPS(Zhang等,2018年)测量知觉相似度.

blocks.en:
For 4D-consistent reconstruction, we use additional consistency metrics.
Specifically, we first optimize a 4DGS representation ( Wang et al., 2025e ) using the enhanced videos together with the input captures.
We then render videos from the camera poses corresponding to the enhanced videos and compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS between the enhanced videos and the corresponding renderings.
We use the subscript c c to denote these metrics, e.g., PSNR c .
For temporal consistency, we report the optical-flow-based Temporal Warping Error (TWE) ( Lai et al., 2018 ) , which measures the residual between adjacent frames after flow-based warping over non-occluded regions; lower values indicate greater temporal stability.
Because temporal smoothing can also reduce this error, we use TWE as a complementary stability metric rather than a measure of reconstruction fidelity.

blocks.en:
We compare RealMe with optimization-based and generation-based baselines under the same sparse-capture setting.
Quantitative results are reported in Tab. 1 , and qualitative comparisons on RealVV are shown in Fig. 5 .
RealMe achieves the best visual quality among all compared methods across both datasets.
When optimizing the 4D representation directly from sparse input views, FTGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) produces lower-quality novel views because the sparse observations provide insufficient constraints for unseen regions and view-dependent appearance.
In contrast, RealMe derives scene structure from sparse input views and recovers the missing appearance.
In addition to the optimization-based baseline, the generation-based baselines exhibit different limitations.
DIFIX3D+ ( Wu et al., 2025b ) improves local details, but it does not consistently preserve the target scene appearance.
Diffuman4D ( Jin et al., 2025 ) focuses on full-body human reconstruction and therefore cannot model scene backgrounds.
Due to the domain gap in its training data, it also does not generalize well to zoomed-in long-focus views in RealVV .

blocks.en: 5.3. Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3. 读取研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies to assess the contribution of the model adaptations and training objective used in RealMe.
We additionally vary the number of input views to analyze the trade-off between capture requirements and reconstruction quality.
All ablation studies are performed on the evaluation sequences of the RealVV dataset.

blocks.en: 5.3.1. Ablation on the Number of Input Views
blocks.zh: 5.3.1. 关于输入视图数量的规定

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 5 , we evaluate RealMe with different numbers of input views to study the trade-off between capture requirements and reconstruction quality.
The results show that RealMe works across the evaluated input-view settings, with a substantial improvement from four to eight views and only limited additional benefits from increasing to 16 views.
We therefore use eight spatially distributed views as the default setting because they provide a practical balance between capture requirements and reconstruction quality.
In practical applications, selecting the number of input views involves the same trade-off: film-production and studio settings that prioritize reconstruction quality favor more views, whereas outdoor captures with limited equipment favor fewer views.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所显示. 5,我们用不同数量的输入观点来评价RealMe,研究捕获要求与重建质量之间的取舍.
结果显示,RealMe在整个评价的输入-视图设置中工作,从4个视图到8个视图有很大改善,从增加至16个视图的额外收益有限。
因此,我们使用8个空间分布的观点作为默认设置,因为这些观点在捕捉要求和重建质量之间提供了实际平衡。
在实际应用中,选择输入视图的数量涉及相同的取舍:电影制作和工作室设置优先考虑重建质量偏好更多视图,而室外捕获设备有限则偏好更少的视图.

blocks.en: 5.3.2. Ablation on Model Components
blocks.zh: 5.3.2. 关于示范部件的规定

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 6 , we evaluate the layout-aware positional embedding and factorized spatio-temporal attention by removing each one from the full model.
The variant without layout-aware positional embedding uses the original positional embedding, while the variant without factorized spatio-temporal attention replaces it with full attention.
Removing layout-aware positional embedding lowers PSNR c , suggesting that layout-aware positional signals help preserve downstream 4D consistency.
Replacing factorized spatio-temporal attention with full attention reduces both visual quality and consistency metrics, indicating that full attention over flattened tokens is less effective for the sampled video group.
Together, these ablations show that both components contribute to visual fidelity and downstream 4D consistency.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en:
We present RealMe, a unified framework that enhances sparse and low-quality input captures into high-resolution, 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction.
The framework adapts the pretrained high-resolution image diffusion model ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) to model temporal dependencies and spatial relationships while preserving local details.
Specifically, we construct auxiliary videos from the input captures as conditioning inputs for the video diffusion model.
It extends the original positional IDs with temporal and spatial indices and applies factorized spatio-temporal attention along these dimensions, improving the 4D consistency of generated videos.
Training further applies a latent frequency loss to reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures.
Experiments on our self-captured dataset RealVV and the public DNA-Rendering benchmark ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) show that RealMe achieves superior visual quality and 4D consistency over existing baselines, while extending volumetric video reconstruction to 2K resolution under limited capture conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们提出RealMe,一个统一的框架,它能加强稀有和低质量的输入捕捉到高分辨率,4D相容的视频,用于量子视频重建.
该框架在保留局部细节的同时,将预先训练的高分辨率图像传播模型(Black Forest Labs, 2024)以模拟时间依赖性和空间关系.
具体来说,我们从输入捕获中构建辅助视频,作为视频传播模型的调制输入.
它以时间和空间指数来扩展原始位置ID,并沿这些维度应用因子化的斯皮提奥-时态关注,提高了所生成视频的4D一致性.
培训进一步利用潜在的频率损失来缩小生成的视频与真实捕获之间的数据差距。
对自取自取数据集RealVV和公用DNA渲染基准(Cheng等,2023年)的实验显示,RealMe比现有基线达到更高的视觉质量和4D一致性,同时在有限的捕捉条件下将量子视频重建扩展到2K分辨率.

blocks.en:
Although RealMe achieves high-quality volumetric video reconstruction with improved 4D consistency, it still has several limitations.
Due to the scarcity of high-quality multi-view datasets, our training data remains constrained, and the model shows limited generalization to large scenes or complex camera settings.
The method may fail when the input captures provide insufficient geometric cues to initialize a valid coarse 4DGS.
How to scale up training data and accelerate high-resolution diffusion inference remain important directions for our future work.

blocks.en: Appendix A Baseline Settings
blocks.zh: 附录A 基线设置

blocks.en:
This section details the baseline configurations used in our evaluation.
To keep the comparisons consistent, each baseline uses the same input views and frame ranges as the main experiments whenever it supports the same inputs.
We rely on official implementations and released checkpoints when available, and resize the outputs to the ground-truth resolution before computing metrics.
blocks.zh:
本节详细介绍我们评价中使用的基准配置。
为了保持比较的一致性,每个基准只要支持同样的输入,就使用与主要实验相同的输入视图和帧范围.
我们依靠正式执行和在有检查站时放行检查站,在计算衡量标准之前,将产出调整为地面真相解决办法。

blocks.en:
For the 4DGS baseline, we use FTGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) implemented with EasyVolcap ( Xu et al., 2023 ) .
The optimization follows the training settings of the original FTGS paper.
Given the same sparse input captures as RealMe, we optimize a dynamic Gaussian representation, render the held-out views, and compute novel-view metrics against the ground-truth videos.
blocks.zh:
关于4DGS基线,我们使用与EasyVolcap(徐等,2023年)共同实施的FTGS(Wang等,2025e.).
优化遵循了FTGS原始论文的训练设置.
鉴于与RealMe一样少见的输入捕捉,我们优化了动态的高斯人代表,提出了被搁置的观点,并对照地面真实视频计算出小说取景量。

blocks.en:
We use the official PyTorch implementation of 4C4D ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and optimize a separate representation for each evaluated sequence.
We use four spatially distributed input cameras and the frame range defined by the four-camera evaluation setting.
Following the official pipeline, we initialize the Gaussian point cloud from the four training views with MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) and retain the released configuration, including 30,000 optimization iterations.
We render the held-out cameras from the final checkpoint and pass the resulting full-frame images to the common novel-view evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们使用正式的PyTorch执行4C4D(周等,2026年),并优化每个被评价序列的单独代表.
我们使用四个空间分布的输入相机和由四相机评价设定确定的帧范围.
在正式管线通车后,将高斯点云从MASt3R(Leroy等,2024年)的4个训练视图中初始化并保留了所发布的配置,包括3万个优化迭代.
我们从最后的检查站制作被搁置的相机,并将由此产生的全帧图像传递给共同的新颖观点评价管道。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 4K4D ( Xu et al., 2024b ) using its official EasyVolcap-based implementation and train a separate model for each evaluated sequence.
We adapt the released custom-dataset configuration to the calibrated RGB frames and camera parameters of RealVV , restrict the training-view list to four cameras and the corresponding evaluation frame range, and retain the official 1,600-epoch schedule and remaining model and optimization settings.
After optimization, we render the held-out camera views and evaluate the full-frame outputs with the same resizing and metric computation used for the other methods.
blocks.zh:
我们使用其基于EasyVolcap的官方实施来评价4K4D(徐等,2024b),并为每个被评价的序列培训一个单独的模型.
我们根据RealVV的校正RGB帧和相机参数来调整所发布的自定义数据集配置,将训练-取景列表限制在4个相机和相应的评价帧范围,并保留1600个正时段表和所剩模型和优化设置.
在优化后,我们用其他方法所用的同样尺寸和度量计算方法,制作被搁置的相机视图并评价整个框架的产出。

blocks.en:
We evaluate DIFIX3D+ ( Wu et al., 2025b ) as the diffusion-based enhancement baseline for sparse-view 3D reconstruction.
We use the official code and checkpoint, with the released difix_ref model.
For each target view, the input view with the nearest camera pose is selected as the reference view.
The enhanced views are then passed to the same evaluation pipeline used by our method.
blocks.zh:
我们评价DIFIX3D+(Wu等,2025年b)是稀有视野3D重建的以传播为基础的增强基线。
我们使用官方代码和检查点,同时发布difix_ref模型.
对于每个目标视图,选择最接近相机的输入视图作为参考视图.
然后将增强的意见转至我们的方法所采用的同样的评价程序。

blocks.en:
We use Diffuman4D ( Jin et al., 2025 ) as the sparse-view human reconstruction baseline.
This method models sparse-view videos with spatio-temporal diffusion, and we evaluate it in a zero-shot manner using the official code and pretrained checkpoint.
Since Diffuman4D is designed for human performance reconstruction, we compute its metrics inside the foreground mask, so the evaluation focuses on the region modeled by the baseline.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Diffuman4D(Jin等,2025年)作为人文重建的稀有视角基线.
这种方法模拟了短视的视频,并带有斯皮提奥-时相传播,我们用官方代码和预先训练的检查点以零镜头的方式评价.
由于Diffuman4D是为人类的性能重建而设计的,所以我们计算其前罩内的度量衡,所以评价的重点是以基线为模型的区域.

blocks.en:
For detail enhancement, we compare with two video super-resolution baselines, STAR ( Xie et al., 2025 ) and FlashVSR ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) .
We use their official code and released checkpoints, with input videos trimmed to the same frame range as our setting.
Because these methods generate outputs at their default resolutions, we resize the results to the ground-truth resolution before computing PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
blocks.zh:
关于细节增强,我们比较了两个视频超分辨率基线:STAR(Xie等,2025年)和FlashVSR(Zhuang等,2025年).
我们使用他们的官方代码,并放出检查站,其中输入视频被剪接到与我们设定相同的帧范围.
因为这些方法在它们的默认分辨率下产生输出,所以我们在计算PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS之前,将结果调整为地面真实分辨率.

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: B.1. Model Architecture
blocks.zh: B.1. 示范建筑

blocks.en:
Our video diffusion model is built on FLUX.1 [dev] ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) and implemented with DiffSynth-Studio ( ModelScope Community, 2024 ) .
A ControlNet branch ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) injects conditioning signals from the auxiliary videos into the diffusion model.
We initialize this branch from the corresponding pretrained DiT weights, which aligns its feature scale with the base model at the start of training.
During adaptation, the full ControlNet branch is trainable.
For the pretrained DiT, we add rank-32 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) to the QKV projections, attention output projections, MLP layers, and modulation/projection layers, while the remaining pretrained DiT weights are frozen.
In both joint and single transformer blocks, each repeated factorized-attention schedule contains three temporal attention blocks followed by one spatial attention block.
We apply temporal attention more frequently because temporal modeling is more challenging than spatial modeling in our capture setting, making the 3:1 ratio a practical trade-off.
blocks.zh:
我们的视频传播模式建于FLUX.1 [dev] (黑森林实验室, 2024年),由DiffSynth-Studio(模范Scope社区, 2024年)实施.
控件 网分站(张等,2023年)从辅助视频中注入调制信号入传播模式.
我们从相应的预训 DiT 权重中初始化这个分支,在训练开始时它的特点尺度与基础模型保持一致.
在改造期间,完整的ControlNet分支可被训练.
对于预受训练的DiT,我们在QKV预测,注意力输出预测,MLP分层和调制/投影分层中加入排名-32的LORA适配器(Hu等,2022年),而剩余的预受训练的DiT分量被冻结.
在联想和单变压器区块中,每个重复的因子化-注意表都包含三个时间性注意区块,后加一个空间性注意区块.
我们更经常地使用时间关注,因为在我们的捕获设定中,时间建模比空间建模更具挑战性,使得3:1的比例成为了实际取舍.

blocks.en: B.2. Training Data
blocks.zh: B.2. 培训数据

blocks.en:
We provide additional details about how the degraded condition videos are synthesized.
(1) For sparse-view and underfit reconstruction degradation, we either uniformly sample 32, 16, or 8 views according to camera poses to reconstruct a coarse 4DGS, or train a 4DGS with all views for 3,000 iterations.
We then render the remaining views or all views as degraded conditions.
(2) For resolution degradation, we use an offline detector ( Guo and Deng, 2024 ) to localize facial regions, pad the detected 2D boxes, and crop local ROI videos.
For blur/resize-based low-resolution generation, we apply USM sharpening and first-stage blur with kernel sizes from 7 to 21.
We sample the configured blur-kernel types with probabilities [ 0.45 , 0.25 , 0.12 , 0.03 , 0.12 , 0.03 ] [0.45,0.25,0.12,0.03,0.12,0.03] , perform stochastic resizing, and use bicubic upsampling to produce 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 condition videos.
(3) For appearance and motion degradation, we follow the degradation design of Real-ESRGAN ( Wang et al., 2021 ) and add random noise, compression artifacts, defocus blur, and motion blur.
Together, these degradations cover geometry artifacts, resolution loss, local detail loss, appearance noise, and motion blur.
blocks.zh:
我们提供更多细节,说明如何合成退化状态的视频。
(1) 对于零星的视野和不适应的重建退化,我们要么用32、16或相机显示的8个视角来重建粗重的4DGS,要么用所有视角来训练3000个迭代的4DGS。
然后,我们将其余观点或所有观点视为退化状况。
(2) 对于分解降解,我们使用离线探测器(Guo and Deng, 2024)将面部区域本地化,将检测到的2D盒放入,并收割本地ROI视频.
对于模糊/基于大小的低分辨生成,我们采用USM磨损和第一阶段与内核大小从7到21相模糊.
我们以概率对配置的模糊内核类型进行抽样[0.45,0.25,0.25,0.12,0.03] [0.45,0.25,0.12,0.03,0.12,0.03],进行分解再分解,并使用双立取样来制作1280×720 1280\times 720个条件视频.
(3) 对于外观和运动降解,我们遵循Real-ESRGAN(Wang等,2021年)的降解设计,并加入随机噪声,压缩文物,去焦模糊,运动模糊等.
这些退化共同覆盖了几何文物,分辨率损失,局部细节损失,外观噪音和运动模糊等.

blocks.en: B.3. Training Strategy
blocks.zh: B.3. 培训战略

blocks.en:
Condition videos are fixed at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution during training.
For target videos, we use a progressive resolution schedule that increases from 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 to 2560 × 1440 2560\times 1440 .
This schedule stabilizes high-resolution training, while the final training stage remains consistent with the 2560 × 1440 2560\times 1440 target resolution reported in the main paper.
We sample temporal, spatial, and joint training groups with probabilities 0.4 0.4 , 0.4 0.4 , and 0.2 0.2 , respectively.
Their corresponding window sizes are 4 frames, 4 views, and a 2 × 2 2\times 2 temporal-view group.

对于目标视频,我们使用渐进解析时间表,从1280×720 1280\times 720到2560×1440 2560\times 1440.
这一时间表稳定了高分辨度培训,而最终培训阶段则与正文中所报告的2560×1440 2560\时间1440目标分辨率保持一致.
我们分别对概率为0.4、0.4、0.4和0.2的时空和联合培训小组进行抽样。
其相应的窗口大小为4帧,4取景,并有2×2 2\times 2时间-取景组.

blocks.en: B.5. 4DGS Reconstruction
blocks.zh: B.5. 4DGS 重建

blocks.en:
Novel-view renderings and cropped ROI videos are maintained as separate condition types, enhanced independently, and converted to the same output resolution.
For each sequence, the final 4DGS is supervised by eight original capture views and 40 generated views enhanced from the novel-view and ROI conditions.
We map enhanced ROI videos back to their full-frame camera coordinates using the recorded crop boxes before reconstruction.
Raw captures and enhanced videos use the same supervision type and loss weight.
Following FTGS ( Wang et al., 2025e ) , we optimize one unified 4D Gaussian representation for the full scene and retain the remaining FTGS settings.
Foreground masks are used only for the Diffuman4D-aligned evaluation and are not used for training or the other experiments.
blocks.zh:
小说-取景渲染和被收割的ROI视频作为单独的条件类型进行维护,独立增强,并转换为相同的输出分辨率.
对于每个序列,最终的4DGS由8个原始的捕捉视图和40个由小说-取景和ROI条件增强而来的观点监督.
我们在重建前利用收录的收割箱,将强化的ROI视频映射到其全帧相机坐标上.
原始捕捉和增强视频使用相同的监督类型和减重.
继FTGS(Wang等,2025e.)之后,我们优化了全场一个统一的4D高斯代表并保留了剩余的FTGS设置.
前景口罩仅用于Diffuman4D相通评价,不用于训练或其他实验.

blocks.en: B.6. Input Synchronization and Efficiency
blocks.zh: B.6. 投入同步和效率

blocks.en:
The method accepts unsynchronized camera videos when their time offsets are annotated. We use these offsets to associate sampled frames with a common scene timeline before constructing temporal and joint training groups.
Runtime and peak memory are measured for diffusion inference only, using one 4-frame 2560 × 1440 2560\times 1440 batch with 30 denoising steps on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU; the results are reported in Tab. 8 .

该方法接受不同步相机视频,当其时间相抵被附加注释时. 我们利用这些冲抵,在建立时间和联合培训小组之前,将抽样框架与共同场景时间表联系起来。
运行时间和峰值内存的测量仅用于扩散推论,使用一款4帧2560×1440 2560\times 1440批,单NVIDIA H100 GPU上有30个去诺步骤;结果在Tab中报告. 8 (英语).

blocks.en: C.3. Qualitative Ablation Results
blocks.zh: C.3. 定性结果

blocks.en:
We provide qualitative ablation results for layout-aware positional embedding, factorized spatio-temporal attention, and latent frequency loss.
These visual comparisons complement the ablation tables in the main paper by showing how each component affects local detail quality and 4D consistency across time and views.
In Fig. 10 , we visualize the effect of latent frequency loss in both RGB space and latent frequency space.
The low-frequency maps capture coarse structure, while the high-frequency maps highlight local texture and boundary details.
With latent frequency loss, the generated results retain sharper high-frequency structures and reduce visible detail errors.
blocks.zh:
我们为布局意识定位嵌入、因地制宜的时空注意力和潜在频率损失提供定性减值结果。
这些可视化比较通过显示每个组件如何影响本地细节质量和不同时间和不同观点的4D一致性来补充了正文中的剪接表.
在图10中,我们可视化RGB空间和潜在频率空间中潜在频率损失的影响。
低频地图捕捉粗糙的结构,而高频地图则突出局部纹理和边界细节.
随着潜在的频率损失,所生成的结果保留了更尖锐的高频结构并减少了可见的细节出错.

The latent maps show that LFL better preserves high-frequency structures such as silhouettes, facial details, and clothing boundaries, complementing the quantitative ablation in the main paper. Qualitative ablation on latent frequency loss.
